paragraphs: Shmuel bar Nachum, Bava Kamma 55a. Another Amora named Nachum is mentioned in Shabbat 88b, but Hyman says the name there should read R' Tanchum, as in Sukkah 5a.[^1]

notes.text: נה./פח:/ה. give 55a/88b/5a conventionally without fresh verification. There refers to Shabbat’s Nachum reading, with Sukkah the parallel supporting Hyman’s correction, not itself being emended. The prophet Nachum in the parenthesis, Shmuel’s patronymic and another-Amora occurrence remain separate uses, with no identity merge. Prophet/Amora are supplied classifications only; Tanchum’s title remains R'.
